summary: Backend-only validation of the admin dashboard 'infinite spinner' fix on PRODUCTION (https://cinemaries.fr). 3 tests PASSED: (1) invalid Bearer token on /api/admin/stats correctly returns 401 (which is what the new frontend global 401 handler consumes); (2) missing Authorization header returns 401/403; (3) Nginx redirect http://cinemaries.com/ -> https://cinemaries.fr/ is a 301 followed by a 200 on .fr. BLOCKER: 4 tests could not run because BOTH production credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md are currently rejected with HTTP 401 'Identifiants incorrects': (a) contact@cinemaries.fr / Reset2026! (also tried Reset2026New!), (b) test@wedding.fr / test1234. Backend itself is healthy (POST /api/auth/login with empty body returns 422; unknown routes return 404), so the login logic is up — only the passwords no longer match what the DB stores. This blocks Test 2 (valid admin -> 200 on /admin/stats with users/premium/videos/codes_total), Test 4 endpoints (/auth/me, /auth/2fa/status), and Test 5 (non-admin -> 403). The 401-handling half of the fix (frontend contract) is verified; the admin-authorized path could not be verified end-to-end due to the credentials issue.

critical.issue: Admin account contact@cinemaries.fr rejects BOTH Reset2026! and Reset2026New! with 401 'Identifiants incorrects'. Same account was successfully rotated + reverted in iteration_9. Either the password was changed again out-of-band, or is_active was flipped, or the passlib 'wrap detection' bug flagged in iteration_9 re-appeared. Cannot verify /api/admin/stats 200 path without an admin token.
Client account test@wedding.fr / test1234 also returns 401. Blocks the non-admin 403 security test on /api/admin/stats.

minor.issue: Returns 404 in production — no health endpoint is exposed, which makes ops probes harder. Not part of this fix but worth adding.

action_items: URGENT: Re-reset the admin password for contact@cinemaries.fr (bcrypt-direct, same procedure as iteration_9) so ops + tests can authenticate again. Confirm is_active=true, two_fa_enabled=false. Then update /app/memory/test_credentials.md if the value changes.
URGENT: Verify test@wedding.fr / test1234 in the prod users collection — either re-seed it or update test_credentials.md to reflect the real value.

Once credentials are restored, re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_dashboard_401_fix.py -v — the 4 blocked tests should then confirm /api/admin/stats returns 200 with keys {users, premium, videos, codes_total}, /auth/me and /auth/2fa/status work, and a non-admin token gets 403 on /admin/stats.
Consider adding a /api/health endpoint (returns 200) so the dashboard/uptime probes can detect prod outages cleanly.

Investigate why admin credentials keep drifting on production between test runs — likely the passlib bcrypt wrap-detection bug flagged in iteration_9 has NOT been fixed at the source and is silently corrupting the stored hash on every /auth/change-password call.
critical_code_review_comments: The 401 contract on /api/admin/stats is correct and stable: invalid token -> 401, missing token -> 401/403. The frontend 'cm:unauthorized' global handler will therefore fire reliably and eliminate the infinite spinner regardless of why the token became invalid (stale, expired, revoked).
Nginx server block for cinemaries.com -> https://cinemaries.fr is a proper 301 (permanent). Good for SEO + saves the user from the SSL error they hit.
